Risk transfer mechanisms:
  - cyber-insurance policy
      (subject to exclusions, caps, control prerequisites)
  - contractual risk allocation
      (vendor liability, indemnification clauses)

Transfer changes WHO PAYS.
It does not change whether the exposure still exists.
caption: An indemnification clause is only worth as much as the other party can actually pay.
